title: Number of Sexual Crime Offenders who Have Escaped Mandatory Caning Due to Age
what_it_is: Number of Sexual Crime Offenders who Have Escaped Mandatory Caning Due to Age

sections.label: Caning age limit offenders
sections.summary: In the past five years, 13 offenders above 50 convicted of aggravated rape and aggravated sexual assault by penetration were not caned due to being above 50, with courts able to impose up to 12 months' additional imprisonment instead.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Home Affairs (a) in the past five years, how many persons have escaped the imposition of the mandatory caning sentences upon being convicted for committing serious sexual offences such as rape by reason of them being above the age of 50; and (b) whether the Government has plans to remove the age requirement in order that all such convicted persons, irrespective of their age, will be imposed caning sentences so long as they are assessed to be medically fit.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: There are two serious sexual offences in the Penal Code that attract mandatory caning, namely: aggravated rape and aggravated sexual assault by penetration.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: In the past five years, 13 offenders above 50 years old were convicted of these offences.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Caning was not imposed on them, as they were above 50 years old.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: For such offenders, the courts have the discretion to impose an additional imprisonment term of up to 12 months in lieu of the caning.

sections.label: Review of caning age limit
sections.summary: The age limit for caning is a colonial legacy interpreted as a proxy to screen out those likely unfit, and the Government will review it among other things.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: Indeed, the age limit for caning is a colonial legacy passed by the Legislative Council of the Straits Settlements.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: And the Singapore courts have interpreted the age limit as a proxy to screen out those who are likely to be unfit for caning.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: The Government, as I have mentioned earlier, regularly reviews Singapore's criminal justice policies including our policies on caning.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: We will look at the trends and statistics of offenders above 50 years old who commit serious offences and review, among other things, the age limit of caning.
